items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: The other cornet players were people like Nick LaRocca, you know, I shouldn't mention names.

ctx.x: Emmett Hardy, no. Some people you know rave about how... I have heard nothing but good about him.

I've heard nothing but good. That's right. But not everybody... Yeah. ...says he was great. So he certainly must have been. He must have been. So as I say, I never heard those people. I never heard Dick Mackie until I was grown and Dick Mackie was very good. Now, nobody ever heard of Dick Mackie, you see. And yet he was one of the finest cornet, white cornet players I know that was ever produced in New Orleans. Yeah. The other cornet players were people like Nick LaRocca, you know, I shouldn't mention names.…
When did you first hear Oliver that you can remember?
